environment.description: ASP.NET Core 8.0 application running as 'www-data' user on Ubuntu 22.04 LTS in a Docker container with --security-opt apparmor=unconfined. The container runs with default seccomp profile but no MAC enforcement. UPLOAD_DIR is set to /tmp which is a shared tmpfs mount. Other containers in the pod also mount the same /tmp volume. No file integrity monitoring. The application pool runs with CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE capability retained.
